title: Kenai Fjords Tours (Anchorage)
blurb: Guests cruise up the coast from Seward on narrated ocean cruises to see abundant wildlife and incredible landscapes including glaciers, forests, and rock walls. Tours explore Kenai Fjords National Park with opportunities to see whales, sea otters, sea lions, puffins, and more. Some tours include multi-course dinners glacier-side or special editions with the Alaska SeaLife Center.
